steps.u: Players report rubber-banding every few minutes on the EU shard only. Server tick logs attached. What's going on?

i.command: grep 'tick overrun' logs/eu-1.log | awk '{print $1}' | cut -c1-5 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -4

steps.a: The overruns come in bursts exactly every 15 minutes: 14:10, 14:25, 14:40, 14:55. Something periodic is blocking the tick thread on EU only.

steps.r:
src/persist/snapshot.rs:21: const SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_SECS: u64 = 900;
config/eu.toml:7: snapshot_sync = true

steps.a: EU is configured with snapshot_sync = true, so the world snapshot is written on the tick thread every 900 seconds; US uses the async path. That matches the burst timing. I haven't flipped it, since sync mode may have been set on purpose for the EU storage backend.

reference.summary: Found why the EU shard rubber-bands: tick overruns occur in bursts every 15 minutes, which matches the world snapshot interval, and the EU config has snapshot_sync enabled so the snapshot blocks the tick thread, while US writes it asynchronously. No change made, since sync mode may be deliberate.
facts: 148 tick overruns on EU versus 3 on US
specific: periodic blocking of the game tick
synchronous snapshot on the main loop
